coverageMeaning: Proposed Full accounts for source-fit tasks and conditions, not a child result or complete contributing-topic certificate. The five intrinsic corrections are independently reviewed prerequisites to publishing affected graph links; no automatic Full from edge labels.

records.rationale: Awareness is demonstrated through actual safe choices/action in a protected local walking/road case, with complete everyday-safety checks retained separately.
The relevant declared traffic/hazard symbol set is interpreted with the stated limited prompting, and its practical action is checked. No claim of knowing every locality’s signs is made.
Actual careful handling of study materials is checked in the school case, alongside relevant complete craft/material-care checks.
Actual appropriate participation in cleaning declared school spaces, including the classroom/play/handwashing-area cases, is retained rather than replaced by a discussion about rules.

records.retainedSourceCondition: Retain the selected source wet/dry classification explicitly; actual disposal follows the supplied current local stream information, without asserting all waste belongs to only those two groups. Complete sorting/count/order tasks remain separate canonical checks.
records.rationale: Actual safe source-fit waste separation is demonstrated; the printed wet/dry case and the applicable current disposal context remain distinct. Full classification/count/order evidence is a separate canonical task.

Actual use of suitable scissors/food-cutting/care tools is checked with the source’s supervision or unprompted-performance distinction. No merely verbal safety answer or firmer-vegetable grip inventory substitutes for the selected task.
Actual ingredient choice, a relevant health reason and washing/preparing/combining/serving cover the complete preparation duty; the excessive full-diet prerequisite must first be corrected.
The learner identifies relevant nutritional qualities with actual food examples, keeping foods/groups distinct from nutrient functions and avoiding a blanket good/bad-food label.

records.retainedFunctionalCondition: Actual container/cup/utensil/portion/transfer performance in the source-fit task is checked separately. A complete snack-preparation performance alone does not prove no-spill water/food handling, and this task alone does not certify the whole snack claim.
records.rationale: Actual meal-serving participation and a reasonable initial portion are checked directly, with appropriate appetite/context feedback rather than a fixed universal child amount.
Relevant body benefits are explained and contrasted with genuine food hygiene/allergy/unsafe-food risks. No categorical disease verdict or adult dietary prescription is introduced.
Actual food-group recognition uses the applicable local guide and retains the source-permitted adult assistance. Source-supported performance is separate from the complete Qh whole-card assessment.

records.retainedFunctionalCondition: Actual container/cup/utensil/portion/transfer performance in the source-fit task is checked separately. A complete snack-preparation performance alone does not prove no-spill water/food handling, and this task alone does not certify the whole snack claim.
records.rationale: Actual water collection/transfer into a suitable vessel without spilling is checked directly. The snack-serving component contributes in a declared meal/drink task but does not by itself prove this water-handling performance or whole snack mastery.
Actual independent appropriate handwashing is checked at the stated everyday cues; the whole canonical hygiene portfolio is assessed separately rather than inferred from one wash.
Actual portion selection is checked within the declared meal/appetite situation, without forcing plate-clearing, calorie calculation or a body-weight target.

records.retainedFunctionalCondition: Actual container/cup/utensil/portion/transfer performance in the source-fit task is checked separately. A complete snack-preparation performance alone does not prove no-spill water/food handling, and this task alone does not certify the whole snack claim.
records.rationale: Actual controlled serving without spilling is checked separately from ingredient selection or reciting a recipe. The serving component is direct, while whole snack competence is a separate assessment.
A bodily unwell sign is recognised and communicated to an appropriate helper; no illness diagnosis, forced symptom or emotion-vocabulary inventory is required.
Actual sign interpretation and the corresponding safe action are checked together; the intrinsic whole-book hard gate is corrected before publishing the sign contribution.
Actual care-versus-not-OK distinctions and protective reporting retain both body ownership and the complete no/go/tell task, including that freezing is never the child’s fault.
The offered-gift situation is rehearsed safely with refusal/help options, without implying only unfamiliar people can be unsafe or creating real enticement.
Appropriate helpers beyond parents are identified for declared practical danger/help cases, and a clear help request is demonstrated.

The learner anticipates consequences of breaking a supplied rule for self/others and explains the effects. UHQ is the direct operation; the complete independent rkr why-rules claim is contextual support, not an extra required association.
Actual handling and care of school books/materials/furniture are checked; tidying a craft kit alone does not establish this property-care duty.
Actual appropriate participation in cleaning declared school spaces, including the classroom/play/handwashing-area cases, is retained rather than replaced by a discussion about rules.

records.rationale: Actual safe source-fit waste separation is demonstrated; the printed wet/dry case and the applicable current disposal context remain distinct. Full classification/count/order evidence is a separate canonical task.

Awareness is demonstrated through actual safe choices/action in a protected local walking/road case, with complete everyday-safety checks retained separately.

records.contextualRequirement: Retain food preference/engagement separately from nutritional understanding, actual preparation and not-wasting practice. No compulsory liking, forced tasting, forced plate-clearing or affective score.
records.rationale: Nutritional understanding, actual appropriate preparation and meal stewardship are retained alongside a separate food-preference/engagement channel. Skill performance is not evidence of liking.
The task checks complete basic hygiene, actual self-service and recognising/communicating an unwell state. Handwashing alone is not inferred to prove all self-care.
Actual care, cleaning and organisation of school space and property are checked, with separate full component tasks for hygiene, craft/material care, group contribution and classification/counting.

Actual suitable tool use and safe handling/storage are assessed; supervised and unprompted performance are distinguished from absence of adult oversight. Specific taught care-tool cases remain explicit, without a new per-tool node.
Actual safe action in a protected familiar movement/road case and transfer account for awareness plus behaviour. An illustrative cycling case does not imply universal cycling technique.

Unsafe situations are recognised and an appropriate protective/help response is performed, including reporting to trusted adults. Known people can also be unsafe; body signals are not proof that every unsafe event feels uncomfortable.

An integrated routine and a changed everyday case cover actual meal/self-care, shared-space care, tool use and protective action. The broad goal is reviewed separately rather than inferred from child-code counts.

before.reason: Reading health and safety signs builds on knowing texts take many forms (re-pointed from retired Texts are everywhere)

after.reason: Recognising different forms of messages supports interpreting signs, but classifying story/poem/non-fiction books and explaining author/illustrator roles is not necessary for identifying and acting on health and safety symbols.

dependencyCorrections.independentWholeClaimWitness: A possible learner identifies a poison/hazard symbol and says not to touch and to tell an adult, finds handwashing/first-aid/exit signs and explains their actions, and matches a sun-safe message with its protective strategy. They cannot yet distinguish a poem from a story or name an author/illustrator role. All three DRNX evidence duties are met without the whole gZIo claim.
dependencyCorrections.nearMiss: Naming one red symbol alone would not be enough: the witness includes changed hazard, school and community-message cases plus the instructed action.
dependencyCorrections.evidenceStatus: Logical/assessment-design counterexample, not an observed child study

before.reason: 'Preparing simple healthy snacks' builds on 'Balanced Diet & Food Groups'

after.reason: Understanding a local healthy-eating guide supports ingredient choices and their health rationale; preparing a selected healthy snack safely does not require the complete nutrient-function inventory or planning a whole day of meals in guide proportions.

dependencyCorrections.independentWholeClaimWitness: A possible learner chooses fruit and yoghurt or a suitable vegetable wrap, explains a relevant benefit such as fruit providing fibre/vitamins or yoghurt providing growth material, washes/peels/spreads/cuts soft ingredients with a child-safe knife, combines and serves using picture steps. They perform the whole food-hygiene claim, including hand/surface care, cold-food handling and allergy checks, but cannot yet explain all fat/mineral functions or plan whole-day guide proportions. This meets the entire snack claim while Qh is incomplete.
dependencyCorrections.nearMiss: Following an adult-selected snack with no ingredient choice or health reason would not meet F62; the witness deliberately includes those complete requirements.
dependencyCorrections.evidenceStatus: Logical/assessment-design counterexample, not an observed child study

before.reason: Understanding that actions have consequences requires the vocabulary word 'consequence' as a named concept

after.reason: Decision and safety vocabulary supports talking about consequences; understanding and predicting effects of actions does not depend on the full rule/fair/honest/trusted-adult vocabulary inventory or on using a particular label for the concept.

dependencyCorrections.independentWholeClaimWitness: A possible learner describes a consequence of their own everyday action, predicts that snatching a shared toy may upset a peer or starting to clear a spill helps others, and explains positive/negative effects for self and others before choosing an action. They use ordinary words or an appropriately communicated cause/result account, but cannot yet define every term in uTK. Every UHQ evidence facet is met without the whole vocabulary claim.
dependencyCorrections.nearMiss: A single memorised cause-effect pair is not enough; the witness spans own action, prediction, and consequences for oneself and others.
dependencyCorrections.evidenceStatus: Logical/assessment-design counterexample, not an observed child study

before.reason: Taking turns and sharing cooperatively requires vocabulary like 'cooperate', 'take turns', and 'include'

after.reason: Cooperation vocabulary supports discussing turn-taking and sharing; actually taking turns, sharing materials and explaining the benefit of fair participation does not require the entire compromise/active-listening vocabulary claim.

dependencyCorrections.independentWholeClaimWitness: A possible learner waits and takes turns in a familiar game without adult reminders, voluntarily shares materials during a joint activity and explains that everyone gets a chance so the game works/enjoyment is shared. They cannot yet define compromise or active listening. The complete FwI operation is demonstrated without the whole NS5 inventory.
dependencyCorrections.nearMiss: Silent compliance while an adult controls every turn does not meet the witness; independent turn-taking, actual sharing and a reason are retained.
dependencyCorrections.evidenceStatus: Logical/assessment-design counterexample, not an observed child study

before.reason: Active listening practice requires understanding the vocabulary of listening, agreeing, and disagreeing respectfully

after.reason: Working-with-others vocabulary supports reflecting on listening; attending to a speaker, waiting and responding to their actual meaning does not require mastering every term used to describe group work.

dependencyCorrections.independentWholeClaimWitness: A possible learner faces and attends to a peer describing an event, waits for the peer to finish, and answers a relevant question or responds to that event instead of changing the subject. They cannot yet explain compromise or define the metaterm active listening. All YbX evidence requirements are met without the whole NS5 vocabulary claim.
dependencyCorrections.nearMiss: Looking at someone or reciting a listening rule alone would not meet YbX; relevant response to the actual message is required.
dependencyCorrections.evidenceStatus: Logical/assessment-design counterexample, not an observed child study

limits: Legacy activities and confidence ratings are not fresh efficacy validation; unverified source flags and review notes remain disclosed.
The source wet/dry duty does not imply the whole counting/cardinality chain; all canonical count-out, arrangement and category-count checks are assessed separately.
No named illustrative Tier/age figure is turned into a taxonomy difficulty level.
No raw-food/blindfold/nasal-occlusion activity, adult fluid quantity or fixed child body-weight prescription is imported.

candidateSelectionReconciliation: V6 firm-food bridge/claw inventory omitted from direct simple-tool associations; actual source care-tool/knife conditions remain in protocol.
rkr why-rules omitted from direct consequence position; UHQ directly accounts for its operation, with supplied rule context.
